_note: All numbers are HYPOTHESES until confirmed in Studio play unless status=='fixed'. Units: studs, seconds, studs/s. 'status': fixed = contract constant; hyp = tune in playtest within 'range'.

trialEnabled.note: Daily Stampede hidden from WP-04 until WP-15 re-plans it for loops

worldPartsOnly.note: true = no runtime Terrain; part-slab fallback

worldLegacy.note: arenas still built by the old buildArena during stage 1

jumpHeight.note: Roblox default; arena walls <=5 are player-jumpable, creatures never jump walls

ice.note: client smooths the control vector; no physics friction dependency

speedCurve.note: [t, planar speed]; linear interp; exit blends to walkSpeed over 0.10s

steerFraction.note: how much of live input bends the dash direction; lets players draw arcs

boopShove.note: creatures within boopRadius of the dash segment are shoved this far sideways from the dash line and flagged startled 0.8s

snapRadius.note: head auto-closes onto own ribbon inside this distance

snapMinPathDistance.note: ribbon points nearer than this along the path cannot be snapped to

serverPathTolerance.note: each claimed vertex must lie within this of the server-observed path, and the server path must stay within this of the polygon. Tune from the claimDeviation telemetry (p99 of accepted claims + 1)

captureInflate.note: polygon grown by this for the containment test; errs in the player's favour

pinchAttachRadius.note: ribbon point this close to a pinch wall is attached to it

layerTolerance.note: a creature is catchable only if its ground height is within this of the ground height at the nearest polygon vertex (shelf vs floor, arch deck vs the Run)

viewClockMaxAge.note: lag compensation: creatures are tested where they were at the herd clock the client was rendering, never older than this

pathGapMax.note: a server path with a longer hole than this cannot prove a loop

claimDeferSeconds.note: the server holds a claim this long for its observed path to reach the claim's last vertex

resultTimeout.note: client shows a harmless 'slip' if no result arrives in this time after closing

cutRadiusServerMargin.note: server cut radii are this much smaller than the radius drawn on the client, so latency never cuts a ribbon that looked clear

sizeMultiplier.note: 8 means 8 or more. Strictly increasing per creature so gathering always beats splitting

techs.SNAP: loop closed within scoring.snapWindow of a dash start (server times, +0.15s slack)
techs.TIGHT: n >= 2 and polygon area <= tightAreaBase + tightAreaPerCreature*n; a lone creature is TIGHT only if its species has soloTightArea (creatures.json)
techs.PINCH: loop closed against an arena pinch wall
techs.MEDLEY: 3 or more species in one loop
techs.ROUNDUP: 5-7 creatures in one loop (label only; size multiplier carries the value)

chainWindow.note: base seconds the chain survives after a chain-keeping action (a loop that caught something, a landed wrap, or a bank)

chainTiers.note: [links, multiplier]. The loop that reaches a tier is scored at that tier

chainLinks.note: [minimum creatures in the loop, bonus links]. A loop adds n + bonus links: 1->1, 2->2, 3->4, 4->5, 5->7, 8->10. Replaces 'one link per loop', which rewarded farming singles

chainWindowPerCreature.note: a loop of n refills the timer to chainWindow + this*(n-1), capped at chainWindowMax. Without it the model shows big herded loops lose the chain while singles keep it

medalsProvisional.note: from tools/play_model.py (Meadow slice, no Golden): beginner mean 124, competent p10 795, herding optimizer p10 2546 / p90 3194. Replaces Config.Medals 300/1000/2500/5000 for the slice; recalibrate from real rounds in WP-14

bankMultiplier.note: [parade size at bank, multiplier]. Bank points = sum of carried base values x multiplier, added to round score and paid as glow. Banking also refreshes the chain window

overflow.value: creatures beyond capacity are scored at overflowScoreScale and released (they hop out and respawn normally)

podRespawnPlayerScale.note: more players refill pods faster; the live cap never rises

pitchDegrees.note: lowered after the reference render: at 52 no landmark or horizon is on screen; at 46 the Clover Tree trunk and far field are, and a ring still reads as a clear ellipse (height/width 0.72)

distance.note: at 44 a Spark was about 20 px wide on a 1280 px screen; 38 with creature scale 1.3 gives about 34 px

yawControl.value: player (RMB drag / touch drag / right stick); pitch clamped 38..54

pitchPresets.note: slice debug keys [ and ] step through these so the owner can compare in one session

frameMsDesktopP50.baselineNote: owner's F8 reading in Studio on b1b62fd. The overlay averages RenderStepped dt; in Studio Play that includes the Studio editor and, in Play Solo, the server in the same process. It is a real miss against the 16.7 ms budget but its cause is NOT established: b1b62fd already interpolates creatures on the client with one PivotTo per visible creature per frame. Measure as 11 section 6 before attributing it

localEffectParts.baseline: 124 DESCENDANTS of SparkLocalEffects (b1b62fd counts #GetDescendants(): attachments, emitters, billboards and labels included), so the real part count is unknown and may be under budget
localEffectParts.measure: visible BaseParts only: IsA('BasePart') and Transparency < 1 under workspace.SparkFx

herdBytesPerSecondAvg.baselineNote: 1.7 KB/s was WITHIN b1b62fd's own budget (<= 6 KB/s in the F8 overlay). The 1.2 KB/s target is a new, tighter goal from fewer creatures and an adaptive send rate, not a fix for a failure

creaturePartsMax.baselineNote: b1b62fd creatures are server-created replicated Models of roughly 14-22 welded parts

effectInstances.note: Beams + Trails + enabled ParticleEmitters + enabled BillboardGuis; set from the first real measurement

creaturePartsTotal.note: 30 creatures x <= 9 parts + 32 pooled near-detail parts, rounded

globalScale.note: CreatureKit multiplies every part size and offset in data/models by this. creatures.json silhouette height/width already include it. Behaviour radii are unaffected
